title: finding(console): the docs portal book sidebar drops a doc that names the book's group through its own `group` key from outside the book's package, while the book tree endpoint lists it (scopeDocsToBook)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, reproduced through a public door (class a). Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from the objectui#10188 editor-half dev report (`5915968413`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`), confirmed at the source by the at-tier review of PR objectui#11241 (`5916113264`, non-blocking item 1). ⛔ Not graded here.
Dedup: none of the 92 open objectui issues, nor any closed issue among the 300 most recently updated closed items, names `scopeDocsToBook`, `book-nav`, the book sidebar or `doc.group` in the portal. objectui#10188 (the doc editor and the app-menu `doc` item) is the nearest card; its menu half renders a menu entry to `/docs/:book/:name` and does not change the book sidebar.

## The defect

- `apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts` (objectui `origin/main`), `scopeDocsToBook` (about `:317`): when the book declares a package (its own `packageId`, or a group `package` override), every doc from another package is dropped **before** `resolveBookTree` runs. `DocPage.tsx` (about `:147`), `BookPage.tsx` (about `:29`) and `countBookDocs` / `bookNamedBy` all resolve through it.
- The spec's `resolveBookTree` places a doc by its own `group` key (explicit membership, no package scope), and `GET /api/v1/meta/book/:name/tree` answers `resolveBookTree()` verbatim. So the tree endpoint and the portal sidebar disagree for a doc whose `group` names the book's group while the doc lives outside the book's package: the endpoint lists it, the sidebar does not.
- The docblock's reason ("so the synthetic Uncategorized group stays scoped to the book") is about the catch-all group; the filter also removes docs with explicit `group` membership.

## Measured

The objectui#10188 dev, through Playwright on the published `@objectstack/console` 17.5.0 (`/_console`) and on that branch's console alike. A doc `live_guide` was saved and published from the new doc editor with `group: 'reference'` into book `docprobe_manual`:
- `GET /api/v1/meta/book/docprobe_manual/tree` lists `live_guide` under Reference.
- `/docs/docprobe_manual/live_guide` renders the sidebar text `Probe Manual / Getting started / Welcome / Reference`, with the Reference group empty.
- A doc saved over REST (`probe_curl`) behaves the same, so this is not the editor's doing.

The doc editor (PR objectui#11241) reads placement back through the tree endpoint and claims nothing about the sidebar. An admin who places a doc from the editor will not find it in the portal's book sidebar.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Keep explicit `group` membership through the scoping step, so the package filter only narrows what the synthetic Uncategorized group can collect. Pin the sidebar against the tree endpoint's answer for a runtime-created doc, and keep the existing pin that another package's ungrouped docs stay out of Uncategorized. Whether a doc outside the book's package may join the book at all is a spec reading (`resolveBookTree` at the `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 tag says yes); triage confirms before routing.

Dedupe words: `scopeDocsToBook` · `book sidebar missing doc` · `doc.group portal sidebar` · `env-wide doc book tree` · `runtime doc book navigation`
